document_count.description: Command documents that target a host whose role is a YES role.

function_count.description: Distinct functions whose execution role is a YES role (including any already in the name-based protected list).

function_overlap_count.description: Of function_count, how many are also in the census's protected_ten (already denied by DenyProtectedFunctions).

functions_policy_chars.description: Characters of functions_policy_json (jsonencode emits no whitespace outside strings): the managed-policy limit is 6144.

functions_policy_count.description: 1 when functions_policy_json exists (the root creates the policy with count), else 0.

functions_policy_json.description: The Deny policy document for the function routes; null when no function reaches a YES role.

header.description: The census's own header, passed through.

hosts_policy_json.description: The Deny policy document for the task-definition, command-document and downloaded-prefix routes; null when there is none.

platform_policy_chars.description: Characters of platform_policy_json (the managed-policy limit is 6144).

platform_policy_json.description: The Allow policy document (secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the exact ARNs of the PLATFORM-KEY secrets, CT-a-1 amendment 16); null when there is none.

prefix_count.description: Artifact prefixes a YES host downloads and runs.

respol_policy_chars.description: Characters of respol_policy_json (the managed-policy limit is 6144).

respol_policy_json.description: The Allow policy document for the resource-policy actions (the data's in_allow actions, Resource *); null when there is none.

send_document_count.description: Command documents in the send Allow.

send_policy_chars.description: Characters of send_policy_json (the managed-policy limit is 6144).

send_policy_json.description: The group Allow document (ssm:SendCommand on the command documents, the AWS-RunShellScript document and the instances of the host routes; the result reads): CT-a-1 AMENDMENT 19. null when there is none.

shellwin_f1_in_send_hosts.description: True when the F1 host is also one of the send Allow's instances (the window's Deny of the other hosts would then refuse the F1 host too): the root refuses a plan.

shellwin_open_chars.description: Characters of shellwin_open_json (the managed-policy limit is 6144).

shellwin_open_json.description: The document dell2's own policy takes while the F1 shell window is open (derived from the policy file passed in as dell2_ssm_base); null when none.

task_definition_count.description: Task-definition families whose task or execution role is a YES role.

vendor_policy_chars.description: Characters of vendor_policy_json (the managed-policy limit is 6144).

vendor_policy_json.description: The Allow policy document, part one (secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the exact ARNs of the VENDOR-CREDENTIAL and CLIENT-SESSION secrets); null when there is none.

census.description: The decoded reached-roles census (the root passes jsondecode of tests/reached_roles_census.json; this module reads no file).

dell2_ssm_base.description: The decoded dell2_ssm_policy.json (the root passes jsondecode of it; this module reads no file). The module derives the policy dell2 takes while the F1 shell window is open from it. null = no window document.

document_region.description: The region the command documents are declared in (a document ARN carries it).

respol_data.description: The decoded resource-policy action data (the root passes jsondecode of dell_respol_policy.json, a DATA document: per action in_allow, exclusion, reason; this module reads no file). null = no policy.

vendor_census.description: The decoded vendor-secrets census (the root passes jsondecode of tests/vendor_secrets_census.json; this module reads no file). null = no vendor policy.

apply_respol_allow.description: Keep the resource-policy Allow (cloudops-dell-agent-respol-allow-policy) and its group attachment. The Allow was applied on 2026-10-08 under order NFRA_CTLPLN.TO-APPLY-13, so the default is now true. This variable remains as the one-line way to take the Allow off: -var apply_respol_allow=false plans its removal, which is a never-widen act needing its own pair. It was false until that apply so that no plan could carry the Allow before its pair was signed.

open_dell2_f1_shell_window.description: Open dell2's F1 shell window: dell2 (and only dell2) may ssm:SendCommand with AWS-RunShellScript against the F1 host (the census resident host) alone. Default false = closed: DenyShellDocuments reads as it always has. While open, dell2 is also refused every SendCommand to the group Allow's hosts (IAM cannot pair a document with an instance). Opened and closed on the same ledger legs as the svc-irpt window; hard close 2026-10-09T06:00Z. NFRA_CTLPLN.TO-CT-a-1 AMENDMENT 19.
